prompt:
Our trading desk has a snapshot of 8 live crypto prediction market opportunities stored in `data/processed/market_opportunities.json`. We need you to run our full edge-detection and bet-sizing analysis on all of them and produce a file called `bet_recommendations.json`.

The file should contain only the markets we should actually bet on, with the recommended stake size from our $10,000 bankroll for each, and a brief reason why each was selected or rejected. Some markets should definitely be skipped — dead signals, low-quality technical signals for certain assets, or insufficient edge. Make sure the Kelly sizing is computed correctly for each recommended bet.

This analysis needs to follow the Argus Edge strategy exactly, including all asset-specific calibration rules, the freshness priority system, and the counter-consensus detection logic.
